Around them five men in a half circle lean in and gesture with open hands. The five are painted as dark silhouettes against the bright yard lamps, with no faces to be seen. Behind them rows of parked long-distance buses and dust hanging in the light.

An Ethiopian young man of about the same age, a little taller, with dark brown skin and short black hair, always seen from behind, wearing a blue denim jacket and carrying nothing.
fingerprint.style: Hand-painted gouache illustration with soft visible brush strokes and warm paper grain. The painting fills the whole frame from edge to edge. Muted earth palette with amber and teal accents. Gentle rim light, simple shapes, picture-book composition with the subject in the centre of the frame. No writing or lettering anywhere in the picture: number plates, shop signs and screens are plain blank shapes.
